content.text: I'm a senior front-end engineer with a design background. I design interfaces and build them: **React** and **TypeScript** components, **design systems**, and accessible, responsive layouts. I have done both halves of that job on product teams since 2020, and for clients for twelve years before that.

**Accessibility engineering** is my specialty. At 365 Retail Markets and Gaine Solutions I built WCAG-compliant interfaces, led UI reviews, and was recognized for leadership in accessibility and design standardization. I have since built **AccessBridge**, an automated WCAG / ADA auditing platform that renders every page in a real browser (axe-core + Playwright), and I hold my own products to WCAG 2.1 AA — AAA where it counts.

I prototype in **Figma** and **Penpot** and take the result to production myself, so the design intent survives the build. I also write: documentation, onboarding guides, and front-end style guidelines have been part of every role I've held.

Since 2025 I have designed, built, and operated several live products on my own, including **Groundswell**, a surf-forecasting service in five languages. That work extended my front-end practice into APIs, data, authentication, and billing.
I'm based in **Portugal** and work comfortably with European teams and with the US working day.

content.text: • **Design, build, and operate production web applications end to end** — interface design, **React** / **TypeScript** front end, API, database, and deployment.

• **Built AccessBridge** ([accessbridge.app](https://accessbridge.app)), an accessibility-auditing platform: real-browser scanning (**Playwright + axe-core**), plain-language results with AI-written code fixes, and an interface held to WCAG 2.1 AA.

• **Shipped Groundswell** ([groundswell.surf](https://groundswell.surf)), a global surf-forecasting service: an installable PWA with one report surface serving five languages and eight colour themes, with charts and maps over live forecast data.
• **Built token-based design systems and clickable prototypes** in self-hosted Penpot, kept synchronized with production code.
• **Test-gated delivery:** AI-assisted development (Claude Code) with **Vitest** and **Playwright + axe-core** suites deciding what ships.
• _Stack:_ React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Hono, Node, PostgreSQL / Drizzle, Vercel
• **Designed and built touchscreen and support apps** for senior living facilities using React and Material UI.
• **Created detailed Figma prototypes** and implemented accessible, inclusive interfaces for diverse user groups.
• **Ensured WCAG-compliant layouts**, optimized asset delivery, and improved performance across browsers.
• **Authored internal documentation and onboarding guides**, streamlining developer ramp-up time.
• **Led UI reviews and design consistency efforts** within Agile sprints.
• **Designed and developed Angular + TypeScript web tools** for enterprise data governance.
• **Built the Coperor Console app** with reusable UI components and accessible layouts.
• **Produced Adobe XD prototypes** and front-end style guidelines for engineering teams.
• **Recognized for leadership in UX accessibility and design standardization initiatives**.
• _Stack:_ Angular, TypeScript, Material UI, Adobe XD, Jira, Confluence, Agile
